author: Salem Hilal
description: ScreenHint is a free Mac app that turns any part of your screen into a floating, resizable note that stays on top, so the information you need is always in front of you.
title: ScreenHint - photographic memory at your fingertips
imageAlt: ScreenHint: photographic memory at your fingertips. A figure from an app window floats beside it as a hint.
